items.title: Frank Tate interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: I guess it’s in the Sudhalter book on Bix

ctx.x: Yeah. Quite a practical joker, wasn’t he?

Uh, I didn’t see that. But I mean I heard all the stories. But you know that story about all the bass players on the corner? Well I heard him tell it to some New York people that it took place on Hollywood and Vine and I heard him tell it to some California people and it took place at 52nd and Broadway, and I’ve never met anybody who met anybody who knew anybody who knew anybody that was involved. I really question the whole thing. And then there’s another story, we don’t even have to go into that, you know the…
follow him and he found a two by four and put some oily rags on it and lit him on fire and led the band. Again, I don’t know anybody that ever saw any of this stuff happen.
